description: TanStack Query hooks for sales workflow, invoices, payments, and returns - bridges the service layer to the UI
steps: Create src/hooks/useSalesWorkflow.ts with mutations: useConfirmOrder() (calls confirmOrder service, invalidates sales_orders + inventory queries), useProcessOrder() (calls processOrder), useShipOrder() (calls shipOrder, invalidates sales_orders + inventory + invoices), useDeliverOrder() (calls deliverOrder), useCancelOrder() (calls cancelOrder, invalidates sales_orders + inventory). Each mutation uses useMutation with onSuccess invalidation following the pattern in useSalesOrders.ts

Create src/hooks/useInvoices.ts with: useInvoices(filters) (useQuery listing invoices with status/customer/date filters), useInvoice(id) (single invoice with order details), useGenerateInvoice() (mutation calling service), useEmailInvoice() (mutation), useOutstandingInvoices() (query for unpaid/overdue)
Create src/hooks/usePayments.ts with: usePayments(invoiceId) (payments for an invoice), useRecordPayment() (mutation), useCustomerBalance(customerId) (query for outstanding balance)
Create src/hooks/useReturns.ts with: useReturns(filters) (list returns), useInitiateReturn() (mutation), useApproveReturn() (mutation that restores stock), useReturnHistory(orderId)
acceptance_criteria: All hooks follow existing TanStack Query patterns (queryKey arrays, proper enabled flags, queryClient invalidation)
Mutations properly invalidate related queries on success
TypeScript strict mode passes with zero errors
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm zero errors
findings: All four hook files compile cleanly with tsc -b and vite build. Used direct binary paths (node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b) as documented in FEAT-001 findings. Build produces zero errors.
